# lmw har inspect

List the LinkedIn API calls in a HAR file, or show one

```
lmw har inspect FILE [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --filter string   only calls whose URL contains this text
  -h, --help            help for inspect
      --show int        print the request and response of the entry with this index (default -1)
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --json      print JSON output
  -v, --verbose   show debug logs, including every API request
```
